ai_summary: The program provides funding for capacity-building, community engagement, and research projects in STEM at eligible institutions. Federally recognized Tribal Colleges and Universities, Alaska Native-serving institutions, and Native Hawaiian-serving institutions can apply, with a focus on transformative projects.
ai_quote: "to promote high quality science (including sociology, psychology, anthropology, linguistics, economics and bioeconomics, statistics, and other social and behavioral sciences; natural sciences; computer science..."
